brief.object: A blocky, Minecraft-style grey cat standing on four legs, facing the front (-y). Its tail sticks straight up at the back.
features: boxy head wider than the body, with two square ears on top
light grey muzzle sticking out, with a pink nose and tall black eyes
four separate square legs with light grey feet
tall straight tail standing up at the back
brief.plan: The conversion merged the four legs into one solid block, smeared the face, and gave the body a ragged top. Since the seed is made of simple boxes, rebuild it as clean boxes: separate 2x2 legs (3 bricks tall, feet light grey), a 6-wide body 4 bricks tall, an 8-wide head 1 plate taller than the body, 2x2 ears one brick tall with a light inner patch, a 4-wide muzzle sticking out 2 studs, a 2x1 pink nose on top of it, 1-wide black eyes 4 plates tall, short light grey whiskers out to the sides, and a 2x1 tail 13 plates tall on top of the back of the body. Make everything symmetric about the middle.
brief.finish: Smooth tiles on the body, head, muzzle, whiskers and tail top for the sleek block-cat look, with studs left on the ears for a little texture.
